title: GRADE 10 - UNIT 2 - PRACTICE FOR 15' TEST - EXERCISE 2

cards.front: 11. This beautiful dress _____ for me by my mother last week.
cards.explanation: “last week” → Past Simple. Chủ ngữ “This beautiful dress” nhận hành động → bị động: was + past participle. → was made.

cards.front: 12. Those flowers and plants _____ every day.
cards.explanation: “every day” diễn tả thói quen/lặp lại. Chủ ngữ số nhiều nhận hành động → Present Simple Passive: are watered.

cards.front: 13. Hundreds of films _____ by CGV Cinemas since January.
cards.explanation: “since January” → Present Perfect. Câu ở bị động nên cấu trúc cần là have been + V3. Đáp án B là đáp án dự kiến của nguồn, nhưng dạng chuẩn phải là “have been shown”, không phải “have been showed”.
cards.grammarStructure: Present Perfect Passive: have/has been + V3

cards.explanation: Câu hỏi bị động ở Past Simple: Was/Were + subject + V3? → “When was the telephone invented?”
cards.grammarStructure: Past Simple Passive Question: Was/Were + S + V3?

cards.front: 15. The preparation for the graduation ceremony _____ by the time the students _____.
cards.explanation: “by the time” với một hành động đã hoàn tất trước một hành động quá khứ khác → Past Perfect Passive + Past Simple: had been finished - came.
cards.grammarStructure: Past Perfect Passive: had been + V3

cards.front: 16. Do you hear the footsteps behind us? I think we _____.
cards.explanation: Hành động đang xảy ra ngay lúc nói → Present Continuous Passive: are being followed.
cards.grammarStructure: Present Continuous Passive: am/is/are being + V3

cards.front: 17. My computer _____ by my brother at this time last night.
cards.explanation: “at this time last night” → hành động đang diễn ra tại một thời điểm trong quá khứ. Bị động: was being repaired.
cards.grammarStructure: Past Continuous Passive: was/were being + V3

cards.front: 18. This work _____ by the marketing team next Monday.
cards.explanation: “next Monday” → tương lai. Chủ ngữ “This work” nhận hành động → Future Simple Passive: will be done.
cards.grammarStructure: Future Simple Passive: will be + V3

cards.front: 19. A lot of clean-up activities _____ by our club this weekend.
cards.explanation: “this weekend” và ý định/kế hoạch tương lai → be going to passive. Chủ ngữ số nhiều → are going to be organized.
cards.grammarStructure: Be going to Passive: am/is/are going to be + V3

cards.front: 20. These reports must _____ by the manager.
cards.explanation: Sau modal verb “must”, bị động dùng: must + be + V3. → must be checked.
